sources.ae: this toolkit (2026-09-24): 9 engines moved from Workspace tools/fitness/lib, the adapter, the dispatcher
sources.appbuild: Sol's App Builder Kit 0.1 (~/Documents/app-builder-kit, PR #2 codex/appbuilder-diagnostic, 2026-09-24): its Python runner ported to Node here; entries it contributed carry sol_ids

statuses.available: the engine lives in this toolkit and `ae selftest` proves it, a planted defect going red
statuses.adapter: the app implements it; the adapter's tools.<id>.command runs it. For an app whose adapter gives no command it is blocked (`ae list --repo <app>`)
statuses.pending: being built by the named card (field "card"); nothing runs; a gate bound to it is BLOCKED
statuses.blocked: unconfigured: nothing to run until the app configures it (shown per app by `ae list --repo`)

exit_codes.3: blocked: pending, unconfigured, or not provided by the app

gates_note: The gate menu: the tools that can satisfy each gate. An app binds its own (adapter "gates"); an unbound gate is BLOCKED.
change_classes_source: Union of this toolkit's classes (B2-T9 owner examples: docs-only needs no gate, css-only needs visual and e2e and no performance) and Sol's change rules (their required gates are kept: routing adds contracts and e2e, startup adds architecture, timing, chromium, process and imports). docs-only differs from Sol, who required correctness: the owner's examples win.
default_change_rules_source: Sol's config/project.template.json change_rules; an app's adapter changeRules replace them. Rules union: every rule a path matches adds its classes; a path no rule matches gets default_fallback_classes.

tools.name: Spread and summary statistics: median, MAD, bounds, quantiles, N/min/max/mean/p50-p99/stdev/CV, seeded bootstrap CI
outputs: JSON: n, median, mad, upperBound, lowerBound (CLI); summary(), quantile(), deltaCI() (library)
tools.note: Sol's quantile/summary/bootstrap folded in (one stats module). B2-T1's tools/bench/lib/stats.mjs (on the card) must become a re-export of this file when it merges.

tools.name: Fail-closed threshold gate (max, min, zero, ratchet, ratchetMin, spread)
outputs: PASS/FAIL line with bound and reason

tools.name: Automated performance gate: exactly PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE (bootstrap CIs of p50 and p95 deltas)
inputs: baseline and candidate samples (ms), >= 20 a side
outputs: first line PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; JSON with summaries, deltas, 95% CIs, action
tools.note: Sol's rule: FAIL when a p50 or p95 delta CI lies wholly above +threshold; PASS when the p50 CI lies wholly below -threshold and the p95 CI does not exceed +threshold; else INCONCLUSIVE (keep the baseline). Exit 1 on FAIL only.

tools.name: Paired command benchmark: warmups, N trials alternating baseline/candidate, raw samples, bench.compare verdict, ledger row
outputs: first line PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; raw samples; one append-only ledger row with --ledger
tools.note: New process per trial, alternating order, unpaired bootstrap (Sol's bench_pair). The app's workloads are its commands; cold/warm separation is the workload's.

tools.name: Process-tree PSS/RSS and process count from /proc
outputs: PSS MB, RSS MB, process count, pids; PASS/FAIL with --max-mb

tools.name: Soak runner and leak judge (slope and growth over N cycles)
inputs: samples series (JSON), or in-process runSoak({cycles, warmupCycles, cycle, sample})
outputs: per-key slope/cycle and growth; PASS/FAIL

tools.name: Listening sockets of a process tree (loopback-only gate); declared port registry vs every listener (owner process, duplicates)
inputs: pid, or a port registry [{port, protocol, process_contains}] (adapter "ports")
outputs: sockets with pid/address/loopback; registry problems; exit 3 when no port is declared

tools.name: Cyclomatic complexity ratchet (McCabe) over JS sources
outputs: functions over the ceiling, worst first; PASS/FAIL against --allowed

tools.name: Dead-export detector (exported names no other file mentions)
outputs: file:name of each dead export; PASS/FAIL against --ceiling

tools.name: Architecture rules: forbidden pattern in a set of files (e.g. one pg.Pool owner); a rule matching no file is red
outputs: violations file:line; exit 3 when no rule is configured
tools.note: A regex over source is one piece of evidence, not proof of a single authority; module-graph rules are architecture.dependency-rules (B2-T5).

tools.name: WCAG 2.2 contrast audit of stylesheets (var() resolved, alpha composited)
outputs: pairs under the minimum, unreadable colours, missing stylesheets; PASS/FAIL

tools.name: Colour harmonies on the HSV wheel with WCAG contrast per swatch; --require-aa gate
outputs: palette JSON: hex, contrast, AA normal/large per swatch
tools.note: Contrast is visual/contrast.mjs (one implementation). Hue geometry says nothing about legibility; the ratio does.

tools.name: Interactive colour wheel page with contrast readout (self-contained HTML)
tools.cli: open visual/color-wheel.html in a browser (localhost for the snap browser)
tools.command: open {toolkit}/visual/color-wheel.html (serve over localhost for the snap browser)
outputs: palette JSON (copy button)
tools.note: One self-contained file; its self-test proves the page's inline contrast and harmony math equal visual/contrast.mjs and visual/harmony.mjs and that a planted drift goes red.

tools.name: Design proposals: the app's image generator on a brief must leave >= 2 decodable images before a design question
outputs: images with size and sha256; exit 3 when no generator is configured
tools.note: An app with no generator bound is BLOCKED for design questions: no proposal images, no owner question about looks.

tools.name: Secret leak detector over repo, logs and user data (value never printed)
inputs: secret via env var or file (never argv)
outputs: files and counts only; PASS/FAIL

tools.name: Change classifier: changed paths -> change classes -> required gates (adapter changeRules; fnmatch, * crosses /)
inputs: changed paths or a git base
outputs: classes, required gates, each gate's bound tools and BLOCKED reasons (JSON with --json)
tools.note: Rules are the app's (adapter changeRules); manifest default_change_rules apply when it has none. Workspace main now also carries card B2-T9's tools/gates/{classify,run,receipt}.mjs + matrix.json (merged d122233), the live merge-card gate with B2-T12 provenance and receipts committed under .research-ops. That is a second classifier and receipt writer. Migration (not applied here: it changes the live merge gate, the closer's and owner's call): merge-card.sh calls `ae gates --repo . --base <merge base>` (recorded through tools/obs/record.mjs) and `ae verify`; matrix.json's classes and commands are already the adapter's changeRules and gates; then tools/gates is deleted with tools/test/gates.test.mjs moved onto ae.

tools.name: Gate runner: every required gate's bound tools run; a receipt per gate and a build receipt (BLOCKED when unbound, pending or without a command)
inputs: changed paths or a git base
outputs: <evidenceDir>/runs/<run id>.json per gate and per build; exit 0 only when every required gate PASSed
tools.note: Sol's run_gates: an empty binding is BLOCKED and the build fails. Workspace main now also carries card B2-T9's tools/gates/{classify,run,receipt}.mjs + matrix.json (merged d122233), the live merge-card gate with B2-T12 provenance and receipts committed under .research-ops. That is a second classifier and receipt writer. Migration (not applied here: it changes the live merge gate, the closer's and owner's call): merge-card.sh calls `ae gates --repo . --base <merge base>` (recorded through tools/obs/record.mjs) and `ae verify`; matrix.json's classes and commands are already the adapter's changeRules and gates; then tools/gates is deleted with tools/test/gates.test.mjs moved onto ae.

tools.name: Build receipt verification: hashes, commit, clean tree, adapter sha256, current rules, every required gate PASS, captured-output hashes
outputs: PASS or FAIL with each problem
tools.note: A local receipt is inspectable evidence, not an attestation: CI reruns the gates. Workspace main now also carries card B2-T9's tools/gates/{classify,run,receipt}.mjs + matrix.json (merged d122233), the live merge-card gate with B2-T12 provenance and receipts committed under .research-ops. That is a second classifier and receipt writer. Migration (not applied here: it changes the live merge gate, the closer's and owner's call): merge-card.sh calls `ae gates --repo . --base <merge base>` (recorded through tools/obs/record.mjs) and `ae verify`; matrix.json's classes and commands are already the adapter's changeRules and gates; then tools/gates is deleted with tools/test/gates.test.mjs moved onto ae.

tools.name: Physical acceptance evidence: 36-step checklist, evidence files, HEAD commit, recording >= 15 s with a video stream
inputs: walkthrough log {commit, movie, steps[{id, result, evidence}]}
outputs: PASS/FAIL with each error; movie duration and sha256
tools.note: Checks files and metadata; a reviewer still watches the recording. The checklist is acceptance/acceptance.json (first-class, 36 steps).

tools.name: SQLite plan and timing for one SELECT on a read-only connection; --require-index gate
outputs: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN rows, rows, ms, bytes, full scans
tools.note: Only where an app still uses SQLite; Workspace is PostgreSQL only (D78).

tools.name: PostgreSQL plan summary: rows returned/scanned, index use, inclusive buffers; --require-index and --max-rows-scanned gates
outputs: summary JSON or a verdict line
tools.note: Moved from Workspace tools/measure/pg-profile.mjs summarizePlan (card B2-T6); Workspace imports it.

tools.name: Whole test suite, new-red against the recorded baseline
outputs: pass/fail per file; summary pass= fail= newRed=
tools.note: Sol's unit.run and integration.run were both 'the app supplies its suite as argv'; one entry.

tools.name: Fitness-function runner (checks with thresholds against a baseline; --prove plants defects)
outputs: one line per check; exit 1 on a new red
dependencies: this toolkit's bench.threshold, process.*, architecture.*, visual.contrast, logs.secret-scan
tools.note: config-driven and already app-agnostic in design (--config another project's fitness.config.json); moves in here when a second app adopts it

tools.name: Launch-to-ready latencies, tree memory and Chromium counters, median of N
outputs: per-run and median ms, PSS/RSS, process count, JS heap, DOM nodes
tools.note: B2-T1 extends it (exports its page probes for tools/bench); its private treeRssMb/median duplicate process.pss and bench.stats and should import them once T1 merges

tools.name: End-to-end scripts on the virtual display (real input, CDP reads)
outputs: pass/fail per script; screenshots

tools.name: Physical acceptance flow with database evidence per step
tools.command: adapter tools.acceptance.proof.command (Workspace: node --test tools/e2e/proof-a.e2e.mjs); flows listed in adapter acceptanceFlows
outputs: per-step record with db_evidence; pass/fail

tools.name: Pixel ramp probe of the live UI (theme spread)
inputs: running app on the adapter display
outputs: PNG and spread number

tools.name: Index coverage: every WHERE column set in the stores has an index; the registry listing uses one at 10,000 rows
outputs: node:test results
tools.note: Workspace also runs the source half as the fitness check performance.index-coverage.

tools.name: Timing waterfall from perf_hooks marks across main, RO and renderers
outputs: waterfall JSON and text chart tied to git SHA
tools.note: Merged on Workspace main with card B2-T2 (23ec1f1): WORKSPACE_TRACE=1 launch on :99, main/RO JSONL and renderer marks in one waterfall tied to the git SHA. The in-app tracer is Workspace's core/obs; Sol's timing.node tracer (same role) is therefore not copied: it would be a second tracer.

tools.name: Request-id tracing for IPC, localhost HTTP and DB calls
tools.command: adapter tools.ipc.trace.command (Workspace: the traced run, node tools/measure/waterfall.mjs --runs 1 --json; request spans carry requestId)
outputs: per-request id, caller, destination, duration, status, bytes
tools.note: Merged with card B2-T2: core/obs/trace.mjs (AsyncLocalStorage request ids) around IPC, localhost HTTP and DB calls.

tools.name: One structured JSONL event format and sink
tools.command: adapter tools.logs.events.command (Workspace: the traced run writes the JSONL; node tools/measure/waterfall.mjs --runs 1 --json)
outputs: JSONL: timestamp, process, subsystem, severity, operation, run id, duration, error class, stack
tools.note: Merged with card B2-T2: core/obs/events.mjs, one append-only JSONL format. Sol's logs.validate folds in here.

tools.name: Postgres profiler: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), pg_stat_statements, pool metrics
outputs: JSON: per-query plan, rows returned/scanned, index use, buffers; pool; routing load/reload/lookup; pg_stat_statements and duplicate queries when available
tools.note: Merged on Workspace main with card B2-T6 (a212eb2). Its plan summary moved into this toolkit as database.pg-plan; the profiler (hot queries, pool, routing timings) is Workspace's. Sol's postgres.explain folds in here.

tools.name: API contract tests for every owner and agent action
outputs: node:test results
tools.note: Merged on Workspace main with card B2-T6. Sol's contracts.run folds in here.

tools.name: Migration tests: fresh, previous manifest, populated DB
outputs: node:test results
tools.note: Merged on Workspace main with card B2-T6; test database only (it resets). Sol's migrations.verify folds in here.

tools.name: Failure/chaos tests: Postgres down, plugin throws, timeouts, missed NOTIFY, corrupt config, port taken
outputs: node:test results
tools.note: Merged on Workspace main with card B2-T6 (Postgres down, plugin throws, duplicate plugin, malformed route, PORT_IN_USE). Sol's chaos.run folds in here.

tools.name: Benchmark orchestrator (warmups, N, cold/warm, percentiles, bootstrap CI, env fingerprint, ledger)
tools.command: node tools/bench/run.mjs --workload <name[,name]> --runs N --warmup W [--cold] [--candidate <ref>] [--collect process,memory,cpu,gpu,io] [--seed S] [--json]
outputs: series appended to .research-ops/benchmarks/baselines.jsonl; runs/<id>.json
tools.note: Workspace workloads (launch, Board ready, station switch; cold/warm; collectors) on card B2-T1. Its trials should run through bench.pair and its stats re-export bench.stats; its verdict is bench.compare. No second stats or compare module.

tools.name: Optimization experiment harness (baseline, isolated candidate, compare -> ADOPT/REVERT/KEEP)
outputs: verdict and action
tools.note: Sol's optimization.experiment was bench.pair on two commits plus correctness run separately; B2-T1 builds the harness (worktrees, correctness, resources, ADOPT/REVERT/KEEP).

tools.name: git bisect run step over a benchmark verdict
outputs: bisect exit code

tools.name: Process tree monitor: pid, ppid, role, RSS, CPU %, lifetime, exit
outputs: processes[] over time
tools.note: Sol's integrations/process-sampler.py (Python; descendants with role, RSS, CPU ticks, I/O, fds) is not copied: Python beside process/pss.mjs would be a second /proc reader. Card B2-T3 builds it on process/pss.mjs.

tools.name: Memory profiler: smaps_rollup, status, CDP heap, station-switch leak loop
outputs: RSS, private, shared, heap, peak; after GC

tools.name: CPU profiler: perf stat or /proc stat deltas; node --cpu-prof
outputs: user/sys/wall, cycles, context switches, hot functions
tools.note: Sol: node --cpu-prof <entry>; perf stat optional. Card B2-T3.

tools.name: GPU profiler: nvidia-smi dmon/pmon, GPU process identity, feature status
outputs: utilization, VRAM, GPU process
tools.note: Sol: nvidia-smi dmon/pmon on the app's GPU process. Card B2-T3.

tools.name: Filesystem/I/O profiler: strace -c and /proc/<pid>/io
outputs: opens, reads, writes, fsync, bytes, duplicates
tools.note: Sol: strace -c -f -p <pid>, only under an authorized test workload. Card B2-T3.

tools.name: Chromium profiler over CDP: tracing, Performance, Profiler, HeapProfiler
inputs: named workflow: launch, Board ready, station switch
outputs: scripting, style, layout, paint, composite, long tasks, frames, heap, GC
tools.note: Sol's in-process Electron probe (contentTracing, webContents.debugger Performance, app.getAppMetrics) copied as chromium/electron-probe.mjs, unproven. Card B2-T4 builds the CDP profiler from outside the app (tools/measure/chromium-profile.mjs on the card).

tools.name: Import profiler: module count, graph, waves, durations, loaded-before-needed
outputs: import graph and timings

tools.name: Bundle analyzer over an esbuild metafile (analysis only)
outputs: sizes, modules, duplicates, compressed size
tools.note: Sol's esbuild-metafile report copied as bundle/report.mjs, unproven and with no gate. Card B2-T5 (tools/measure/bundle.mjs on the card) runs the build; the analysis should live here once proven.

tools.name: Dependency/architecture invariants (dependency-cruiser): cycles, forbidden imports, single resolver/pool owner
outputs: rule violations

tools.name: Routing registry profile: route-map load, NOTIFY latency, reload, reconcile
outputs: distributions N>=20, JSON

tools.name: Playwright Electron end-to-end workflows with timing
outputs: Playwright report
tools.note: Sol's Playwright _electron step runner copied as e2e/electron-e2e.mjs, unproven (Workspace has no Playwright installed). Card B2-T7 proves or replaces it.

tools.name: Visual regression: approved references, pixel diff on stable surfaces
outputs: diff images, pass/fail

tools.name: Port registry snapshot and collision check
outputs: listening sockets with owner, unit, classification; check exit 0 free / 1 taken
tools.note: Workspace's 1000-line registry and snapshot/check CLI on card B2-T8. Its registry becomes the adapter's "ports" (checked by ports.listening --adapter); its owner/collision logic folds into ports.listening; no second checker.

tools.name: Routing graph from the implementation vs the declared contract
outputs: JSON + .dot; --check exit 1 on difference

tools.name: Flake detector: each test file N times on its own database
outputs: flake rate per file; FLAKY exits 1

tools.name: Command provenance recorder: SHA, argv, ancestry, unit, exit, output hashes
tools.command: adapter tools.logs.provenance.command (Workspace: node tools/obs/record.mjs --kind <gate|bench|acceptance|e2e> -- <argv...>; the bound command shows the last gate record: node tools/obs/show.mjs last --kind gate)
outputs: .research-ops/provenance/commands.jsonl
tools.note: Merged on Workspace main with card B2-T12 (5b9236e): the recorder wraps merge-card's gate commands. ae receipts (every ae run and ae gates) are the toolkit's own record; the two meet when merge-card runs ae gates (see gates.run).

tools.name: Replay recorded xdotool/CDP flows with pixel, text, element and DB-row checks
outputs: JSON pass/fail report
